description: Get the Dodo Payments checkout link for one RankRoot plan, to hand to the user. The user pays on Dodo Payments and receives a license key by email; pass it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for higher API/MCP limits. If checkoutOpen is false, the plan is not on sale yet: the link is its pricing card where the user can join the waitlist.

plan.description: pass (Launch Kit, $79 once), tracker_m ($29/month) or tracker_y ($290/year) (Growth Tracker), employee_m ($149/month) or employee_y ($1490/year) (Growth Employee, done for you)

name: get_checkout_link
